climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Texas AVA of over 8 million acres on the Llano Estacado, the second largest in the state. Vineyards sit on flat land at 3,000 to 4,000 feet, share it with cotton, sorghum and wheat, and are irrigated from the Ogallala Aquifer.
